title: finding(react): `warnedRefusedDataPropNodes` has no test-only reset while its direct neighbour exports one for exactly that reason — a test asserting the warning is ABSENT is green whatever the renderer does
body:
Path: none | 测试在缺陷与修复上同绿 | 不升级类

`SchemaRenderer.tsx`'s diagnostic dedupe `Set` has **no test-only reset**, while its direct neighbour exports one **for exactly this reason** — so a test that asserts the ABSENCE of that warning passes for the wrong reason, on the defect and on the fix alike.

Seat-verified at source on `origin/main` `aced50d2e`:

```
packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:706   const warnedRefusedDataPropNodes = new Set<string>();
packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:732     if (warnedRefusedDataPropNodes.has(key)) return;
packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:733     warnedRefusedDataPropNodes.add(key);
                                              ⇒ no exported reset anywhere

packages/react/src/utils/propsBagDiagnostic.ts:179   const _warnedPropsBags = new Set<string>();
packages/react/src/utils/propsBagDiagnostic.ts:186   export function __resetDroppedPropsBagWarnings(): void {
packages/react/src/utils/propsBagDiagnostic.ts:187     _warnedPropsBags.clear();
```

⭐ Control in the same command: `__reset` helpers are already **consumed by the suite** — `SchemaRenderer.concealmentGateFaultDiagnostic`, `SchemaRenderer.dataRootUnbound-9308`, `SchemaRenderer.degeneratePropsBag`, `SchemaRenderer.disabledGateFaultDiagnostic`, `SchemaRenderer.nodeGateDataPredicate` all call one ⇒ the idiom exists in this package and this Set is the one outside it.

## The silent direction, in the neighbour's own words

`propsBagDiagnostic.ts`'s doc comment states the failure the reset exists to prevent:

> the second test to assert the same warning reads the first test's dedupe entry and sees silence — **a green run that checked nothing**

⇒ the dangerous shape is a test asserting the warning is **absent** for a `type#id` some earlier test already warned for: it is green **whatever the renderer does**. Reproducer named by the objectui#9758 dev: two `it()` blocks in one file, the first rendering an object-arm node with id `X` and an authored `data` key, the second rendering the same `type#id` and asserting the warning list is empty.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT claim

⛔ Not that any test in the tree is green for this reason today — that census was ⛔ **NOT MEASURED**. The defect is that the guard the sibling module found necessary is absent here, so the next test written against this warning can be silently green.
⛔ Not that the fix is simply 「export a reset」: the sibling's reset is exported from a **utils module**, while this Set lives in `SchemaRenderer.tsx`, whose exports are the package's published surface — so the shape of the remedy (move the diagnostic beside its sibling, or export a `__`-prefixed reset from here) is the claiming seat's call.

## Dedupe words

`warnedRefusedDataPropNodes reset` · `dedupe Set no test reset` · `silent green absent warning` · `__resetDroppedPropsBagWarnings sibling` · `SchemaRenderer diagnostic dedupe`
